about: Places where every bus route drops its lane and is drawn down the middle of the road, bundled together. Use for tight terminals and turnarounds where side-by-side lanes don't fit. radiusM is in meters; routes slide back into their lanes as they leave.

zones.name: Richard L. Gelfond Dr loop
zones.why: Turnaround at the end of a divided road: five routes in lanes filled the gap between the carriageways with a solid square.
